description: Source code for shell help functions in Zephyr OS, including text formatting, help item printing, subcommand help printing, command help printing, and help request detection.

methods.name: formatted_text_print
methods.description: Prints a string on terminal with proper word wrapping and margins.

methods.name: help_item_print
methods.description: Prints a help item with its name and description.

methods.name: z_shell_help_subcmd_print
methods.description: Prints all subcommands of a parent command with help strings.

methods.name: z_shell_help_cmd_print
methods.description: Prints a command and its help description.

methods.name: z_shell_help_request
methods.description: Checks if a string is a help request ('-h' or '--help').
